item.description: Obtain a JWT for FinCapture mobile clients using the same credentials as standard Clearingworks login, in JSON or XML.

item.name: FinCapture User Accounts
item.description: Register remote deposit users, fetch profile and limit information, and look up a specific depositor account for FinCapture. Use during enrollment and before submitting deposits to confirm limits and eligibility.
